diagnosis.reasoning: Prefix cache hit rate and cached-token ratio collapsed by ~92% while the aggregate prompt token rate stayed essentially flat, so the server suddenly has to recompute nearly every prompt token (prefill_kv_computed p99 ~4450). That single change explains the downstream chain: inflated prefill cost, KV usage rising from 0.11 to 0.81, growing waiting queue, and the TTFT regression — with no preemption and no increase in offered load. KV pressure, prefill cost, and queueing are effects on that path rather than independent defects.
